root_cause.text: Caching pointers to IPv6 header fields (saddr, daddr) before a pskb_pull() call that can reallocate skb->head, leading to use-after-free when those stale pointers are later dereferenced.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "Caching saddr and daddr before pskb_pull() is problematic since skb->head can change." The patch removes the temporary variables and instead accesses &ipv6_hdr(skb)->saddr and &ipv6_hdr(skb)->daddr directly at the points of use.

intent_record.how: The behavior is unchanged; the error message still prints the same IPv6 addresses when checksum validation fails, but the code is simpler without the temporary pointers.
